onb.spice.title: How spicy do you like it?
onb.spice.body: Children start mild. I'll learn from your feedback.
onb.diet.title: What does your home eat?
onb.diet.body: This applies to everyone for now. You can set each person on the You tab.
onb.consent.title: Your kitchen, your choice
onb.consent.body: Turn on what you're comfortable with. You can change this anytime.
consent.voice_processing.title: Cook by voice
consent.voice_processing.body: Your voice is turned into text so I can understand you. Recordings are not kept.
consent.memory.title: Remember what we learn
consent.memory.body: Keep tastes from your feedback, like "more garlic next time". You can see and forget each one.
consent.analytics.title: Help improve Cookmate
consent.analytics.body: Share usage counts. Never what you say or cook.
